title: The hidden environmental footprint of digital dentistry
html: Dentistry is undergoing a profound technological transformation.1 Digital tools such as digital radiography, cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT), intraoral scanners, computer-aided design and computer-aided manufacturing, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud-based patient records, virtual treatment planning, and 3-dimensional printing are rapidly reshaping the delivery of oral health care.1 These innovations have improved diagnostic precision, workflow efficiency, communication, and treatment planning, and they have given clinicians unprecedented access to evidence-based information, clinical guidelines, and decision support resources at the point of care.
